tool_arguments.prompt:
Create NEW hand-painted pose drawings from scratch, using the attached adopted neutral solely as exact character identity and drawing-style reference. This is a production sprite image, not a character redesign. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Make a TALL PORTRAIT canvas (1024x1536 or larger native portrait) with EXACTLY THREE separate complete drawings in ONE VERTICAL COLUMN, top/middle/bottom in the order below; each drawing large, centered in its own equally sized band, with generous transparent gutter and padding. No panel boxes, letters, labels, floor, shadow, colored backdrop, effect/speed lines, sparkles, water or props. Preserve the reference warm brown contour, same thin-to-medium edge, simple dot eyes, soft watercolor/paper texture contained entirely within painted silhouette, color blocks, head/body proportions and simplification. Do not become realistic, do not add costume or human limbs. Rust-red back, cream lower face/belly, two small upright forehead barbels and existing short curved whiskers, round fins and fan tail. The three poses must have the same anatomical size and stationary support/body center; do not fit them independently or enlarge quieter poses. Show every appendage without clipping or overlap with other rows.
1. blink: A QUIET BLINK ONLY: close existing dot eyes to simple curved lids; retain precisely the original neutral head angle, head height, trunk shape, ordinary resting limbs and support. Do not nod, elongate neck, sit or raise head.
2. greet: A small welcoming wave with the existing near pectoral fin/flipper; no human hand.
3. present_left: Clearly present toward VIEWER LEFT with an attached existing wing/fin and leftward gaze.
